exposure: first trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cervical ripening balloon (CRB) for induction of labor (IOL)
Cervical ripening balloon (CRB) for induction of labor (IOL)
cohort: Pregnant patients with a singleton pregnancy and a gestational age > 37+0 weeks and no prior vaginal birth undergoing IOL with CRB, from two tertiary medical centers (161 in the TOLAC group and 1577 in the nulliparous group)
finding: Comparable vaginal delivery rates were achieved in patients with or without a previous CD attempting their first trial of labor, with a cervical ripening balloon for labor induction.
mod_finding: The rate of CD was similar in both groups (nulliparous and TOLAC).
